description: This PHP class defines BufferStream, a stream implementation for buffering data in memory, implementing the StreamInterface from the PSR-7 standard. It provides methods for reading, writing, and managing a buffer with a specified high water mark.

classes.name: BufferStream
classes.description: A buffer stream class that provides in-memory buffering with limited size, supporting read/write operations and stream interface compliance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the buffer with an optional high water mark (default 16384).

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the contents of the buffer as a string and clears it.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the buffer content.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Closes the buffer and detaches the stream (returns null).

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is always readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is always writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream cannot be seeked.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the position by seeking to zero.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws runtime exception as seeking is not supported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty, indicating end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws runtime exception as position tracking is not supported.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified length of data from the buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer; returns 0 if high water mark is exceeded.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata, specifically the high water mark if requested.
